verdict.summary: Round 2 resolves the prior major finding. PublicGrant::validate_structure now centralizes the in-memory invariants also enforced after decoding, and wrap_capability invokes it before encoding or encryption. The wire-only canonicality checks remain correctly confined to decode_from because signing_entries itself canonicalizes authority encoding and omits an empty extra-branch field. The new real-path regression test covers unsupported suite, inverted validity, invalid epoch ceiling, non-canonical branch scope, and a valid wrap/unwrap baseline, so the successful-wrap-is-openable invariant is no longer vacuous. No correctness, soundness, security, or test-validity issues remain in the supplied diff.
